name: Take on an apprentice
text: A second job each day, for a wage of 6 denarii a day.

name: Wide laying trowel
text: A bigger brush for laying tiles.

name: Wine jars for the corner
text: A touch of comfort. The dog likes to sleep behind them.

name: Potted plants
text: A little green for the workshop.

name: Better cutting bench
text: Cleaner cuts: stone costs a tenth less.

name: Open the courtyard
text: A second workbench, and one more notice on the board each morning.

name: Glass furnace
text: Make your own glass: glass costs a third less.
